summary: Steep residential kerb with homes 4-11 m away on the east side.

best_section.where: East side, opposite the white car parked mid-block

drivers.seclusion: Homes front straight onto the kerb; 20 m at best on the far side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with a little hard standing beside it.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park along it; no overnight van evidence.

sun_shade: Mostly open to sun; some trees at the northern end.
